name: reldfs-v3 (relational DFS + LightGBM + TabPFN v2 on 3 tasks)
note: Third version of reldfs (#406). CPU-only. Time-cut relational feature synthesis + LightGBM, hand-written point-in-time features (f1, event, trial text score), TabPFN v2 (Prior Labs; Built with PriorLabs-TabPFN) in context on f1 x2 and trial. 10 of the 12 CSVs are the second version's (never filed; local test mean 0.7785). New: the two rel-f1 CSVs use get_db(upto_test_timestamp=False). Rule 1: every feature query filters time < the row's seed time; features at test-era seeds are checked identical against the db truncated before the seed, and a planted leak fails that check. Models are fit on the train and val tables only; no label is rebuilt from rows after the test timestamp. Prepared after the test scores of #406 and of the second version were seen (the f1 val-to-test gap led to this change). All choices made on validation; test scored once (local 12-task mean AUROC 0.7953).
author: KenWuqianghao
